description: Shared positive and negative vectors for the manifest checker (schema_version 1 and proposed 2). Go (apps/whr), scripts/check_repo.py and, after a reviewed resolver change, the host agent read the same file. Cases with document are JSON values; bytes_hex are raw file bytes; raw_text is literal text to parse. expect_codes are the manifest.* finding codes of contracts/cli/validate-findings.json for the manifest alone (an empty list means valid). expect_console_mode, when present, is the effective console mode at use time: an absent field resolves to plain for old and new manifests, while an explicit plain or herdr value is retained. This key does not rewrite the document or change validation findings. This initial set is authored with the spec amendment; work items extend it, and a change needs a reviewed decision. Ownership: T028 owns this file. T028 adds only cases scripts/check_repo.py passes; whichever of T026 and T028 merges second runs every case in CI; later work items that make additional cases visible to Go extend the file through their own reviewed change. Type-exact comparison is required: true is not 1, 1.0 and 1e0 are not 1.

cases.note: version 1 stays exactly four fields
1.0 is not the integer 1
scp-like addresses are refused in the manifest declaration (usage), though validate accepts them in .gitmodules
path derives from projects_path
path must be projects_path/<name> with name derived from the url
booleans are not integers; check_repo.py must compare type-exactly (Python 'True == 1')
exponent spelling is not the integer 1
path name must equal the name derived from the url
yields only this code
the last path component is empty
nesting depth exactly 128 (object, bundles array and 126 arrays) passes the depth bound
depth 129 inside an otherwise valid object
exactly 64 KiB is accepted
well formed percent escapes outside the repository name are accepted and kept verbatim
2048 characters is the longest accepted URL
exactly one trailing .git is removed
.git is removed only as a whole trailing suffix
ports are 1 to 65535
an empty component in the URL path is refused
an integer beyond any implementation's range is a well-formed non-1/2 version, never a syntax error (Python's 4300 digit limit must not leak)
a lone surrogate escape is not valid Unicode text (Go would substitute U+FFFD); refused fail-closed as encoding
a well formed pair is a valid character; the name grammar then refuses it
several findings are reported once each; the set of codes is compared, order is not part of the contract (check_repo.py lists them in the catalogue order of validate-findings.json)
trailing dots and spaces are trimmed from a component before the .git comparison (Windows-style normalization, fail-closed)
only a component that is .git after trimming is refused
an unsupported schema_version ends validation: no path findings are reported
a lone surrogate outranks a repeated key
a component of only dots and spaces is a Windows alias of . or ..
U+FF0E folds to a dot
U+00A0 folds to a space
U+200B is ignored by some file systems
U+3000 folds to a space
8.3 short name of .git
NTFS alternate data stream spelling
a colon alone does not make a component .git
the scheme is compared case-insensitively before the credential test
malformed percent escape alone; the name is valid
no project.path comparison against an unusable projects_path
a syntax error outranks a lone surrogate
nesting is counted for objects as for arrays
128 levels are within the bound; the document is then not a manifest
the resolver admits one trailing dot
U+FEFF is dropped before the comparison
brackets inside a JSON string do not increase structural depth
escaped quotes and backslashes preserve string state during the depth scan
array-only input still rejects a lone surrogate before checking the object shape
